method: Poppler SVG embedded RGB raster; exact color pixel medians, linear interpolation through dashed/occluded gaps; sampled every 2 nm; no fitted peaks
limitations: Approximate raster curves, about 0.66 nm/pixel and 0.0052 relative ordinate/pixel; dashes and occlusion add uncertainty
Spectra in styrene monomer solution, not measured bulk absorption of solid fiber
Relative absorption normalized at each maximum; absolute peak cross section for YS unknown
Shared peak absorption coefficient 0.0147 ppm^-1 mm^-1 and effective 200 ppm are USER-AUTHORIZED TRANSFER ASSUMPTIONS from Y11, not Kuraray YS measurements
Photon/nm emission convention assumed; alternative power/nm supported
Zero dye coefficient outside source support; no invented weak tail
Emission below the two-pixel ordinate floor is truncated to zero within 2 nm of the last resolved point; tails there are unmeasured
Transmission loss is aggregate fiber data and is NOT installed as ordinary ABSLENGTH on top of WLS
